scope: End-to-end purchase flow for TTACart: login, add to cart, cart review, checkout, and order confirmation.
risks: Flaky network may cause time‑outs on page loads.
UI text or element selectors could change, breaking automation.
Test data (cart contents) is reset per run; failures may occur if previous steps do not clean up.
coverage_gap: The library already contains login (valid/invalid) and add‑to‑cart badge tests, but lacks coverage for cart review, checkout information entry, order total verification, and final order confirmation. No full end‑to‑end purchase flow test exists.

test_cases.title: Login with valid credentials redirects to products page
steps: Verify the Products heading is visible
test_cases.expected_result: User lands on the inventory page and sees the product list.

test_cases.title: Login with invalid credentials shows error message
steps: Verify the error alert text is "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"
test_cases.expected_result: Error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

test_cases.title: Add a product to cart updates cart badge
steps: On the inventory page, click "Add to cart" on the first product
Read the cart badge in the header
test_cases.expected_result: The cart badge shows the number 1.

test_cases.title: Cart review shows added product with quantity 1
steps: Add the first product to the cart (see TC-003)
Click the cart icon to navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/cart
Verify the product name appears in the cart list
Verify the quantity displayed for that product is 1
test_cases.expected_result: The cart lists the selected product with a quantity of 1.

test_cases.title: Checkout information entry navigates to overview page
steps: Login and add a product to the cart (see TC-001 and TC-003)
From the cart page, click the "Checkout" button
On the checkout-step-one page, enter First Name "John"
Verify the Checkout Overview page is displayed
test_cases.expected_result: User lands on the Checkout Overview page after providing required information.

test_cases.title: Order total equals item total plus tax
steps: Complete the checkout flow up to the Checkout Overview page (see TC-005)
Verify the calculated sum equals the displayed Total
test_cases.expected_result: The displayed Total matches the sum of Item total and Tax.

test_cases.title: Order confirmation displayed after finishing checkout
steps: Complete the checkout flow up to the Checkout Overview page (see TC-005)
Verify the heading text "Thank you for your order!" is visible
test_cases.expected_result: The order confirmation page with the thank‑you heading is shown.
